Name: Tidy Cozy Ginger Island Farmhouse
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[center][size=3][i][color=#ffe599]Ever wanted to turn your Ginger Island hut into a seashore villa? Now you can!
<---------------------------------------------------->[/color][/i]
[b]This mod turns your Ginger Island FarmHouse map into small and cozy place towards more realistic layout.
Custom balcony, rooftop and cellar included![/b][/size][/center]
[img]https://imgur.com/q1NK10P.png[/img]﻿

[list]
[*][size=3]A whole new Ginger Island farmhouse layout! [/size]
[*][size=3]Custom balcony! [/size]
[*][size=3]Custom cellar![/size]
[*][size=3]Custom rooftop with usable pool![/size]
[*][size=3]Fancy windows&lightbeams![/size]
[*][size=3]Built in recolors![/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][img]https://imgur.com/9t486OJ.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*][size=2]Install all the required mods[/size]
[*][size=2]Unzip "Aimon's Tidy Cozy Ginger Island Farmhouse" archive into Stardew\Mods folder.[/size]
[*][size=2]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[*][size=2]Enjoy.[/size]
[/list][size=2][b]NOTE:[/b] ﻿For stardew 1.5.6 you'll also need Extra Map Layers and Custom Decoration Areas mod
[/size][size=3]Safe to install on already existing save file. NOTE that most of your furniture will be slightly shifted and may be hidden behing walls. Use Noclip Mod to pick it up and relocate.
[/size][size=3]
[/size][center][b][u][size=3]If you want to deinstall this mod, please, pick up all your furniture from farmhouse, rooftop and cellar first - you won't be able to reach it after deinstallation.
[/size][/u][/b][/center][img]https://imgur.com/Zkj4bfv.png[/img]

[list]
[*][size=3]Recolor: Vanilla, Elegant, Rustic Country Town(dark), Rustic Country Town(white), Starblue, Vibrant Pastoral[/size]
[*][size=3]Lighbeams: true/false[/size]
[*][size=3]Kitchen: true/false[/size]
[*][size=3]2nd Floor: true/false[/size]
[*][size=3]Cellar: true/false[/size]
[*][size=3]Cellar Size: big/small[/size]
[/list]
[img]https://imgur.com/B4RHoel.png[/img]

[size=3][b][color=#93c47d]Compatible[/color][/b] with ALL expansions like SVE, Ridgeside, East Scarp, ect...
[b][color=#93c47d]Compatible[/color][/b] with ALL recolors like Earthy Recolor, VPR, Starblue, ect... (But they won't take effect on ginger island farmhouse tiles since I use my own custom tilesheets - you need to change recolors in my mod's config)
[b][color=#93c47d]Compatible [/color][/b]with Lnh's Ginger Island Overhaul
[color=#ffe599][b]Compatibility unknown [/b][/color]- Spouses in Ginger Island
[color=#e06666][b]Not compatible[/b][/color] with mods that edit Ginger Island Farmhouse[/size]

[img]https://imgur.com/tWxt5j1.png[/img]

[size=3]Here's most common bugs you'll encounter (don't worry, it's mostly visual bugs - nothing gamebreaking this time).
If you encounter any bug not listed here, please, report in comments (screenshots of the bug will be much appreciated)![/size]
[center][b][u]NOTE that if you install this mod on already existing save, most of your furniture in Ginger Island farmhouse will be slightly shifted and may be hidden behing walls. Use Noclip Mod to pick it up and relocate.[/u][/b][/center]
